format: Eight-team senior playoff field, no byes. Quarterfinals are 1 vs 8, 2 vs 7, 3 vs 6, and 4 vs 5, each 35 minutes with a 5-minute halftime. Semifinal 1 is the QF2/QF3 winners and Semifinal 2 is the QF1/QF4 winners, also 35 minutes with a 5-minute halftime. Finals Day runs quarterfinals from 8:30 AM, semifinals, a Coaches & Volunteers match, Juniors games, a Dhuhr break, and the 45-minute LSL Championship Final at 2:00 PM, all on Saturday, August 8, 2026.
